svg.title: The story: build, test, ship
svg.desc: Software Engineer across the full SDLC, from development and testing to deployment, building scalable, high-performance backends with Python, SQL and REST APIs. Experienced in containers, orchestration, CI/CD, DevOps and the cloud. Focused on AI/LLM engineering and agentic systems, shipped reliably to production.
